description.zh:
实例类型。取值：
- **replicate**（默认值）：单节点或副本集实例。
- **sharding**：分片集群实例。
description.en:
The category of the instance. Valid values:

- **replicate**: the standalone or replica set instance

- **sharding**: the sharded cluster instance

Default value: **replicate**.

description.zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The number of the page to return. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer parameter. Default value: **1**.

The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**.

> Default value: **30**.

description.zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~)接口查询。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~) operation to query the region ID of the instance.

title.zh: 查询MongoDB实例是否为自动付费

descriptions.zh: > 本接口适用于包年包月付费类型的实例。
descriptions.en: This operation is applicable to subscription instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-instance-auto-renewal-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id dds-bp567b0000 --db-instance-type replicate --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
